dependency_notes: S2 is the riser. Every story that references pageA2 or A2-scoped state — S3, S4, S5, S6, S8 — depends on S2. S4 (group-lifecycle) also depends on S1 because the skeleton must exist first. S3 (per-device commands) requires S4's CgCommand_MD to already be present so the check(m) guards compile against the correct model shape. S5 (assertions) depends on S2 and S3 because the assertion bodies reference command field names. S6 (wire fc.assert) depends on S5 so it can import the assertion functions inline. S7 (doc edit) depends only on S6 being done so the final invariant set (A15, C0, S5, S6, S10) is confirmed before the table row is updated. S8 (wall-clock validation) must run after all of S1–S7 have landed.

stories.name: attach-a2-command
stories.title: AttachA2Command_MD + awaitDeviceJoin: second-device entry path

stories.name: group-lifecycle-commands
stories.title: Group-lifecycle commands: CgCommand_MD, InCommand_MD, LgCommand_MD, RdCommand_MD, FdCommand_MD
stories.description: Implement the five group-lifecycle commands. CgCommand_MD: check guard m.groupId === null && !m.membersA1, dispatches on pageA1, sets m.membersA1 = true and m.groupId. InCommand_MD: check guard m.membersA1 && !m.membersB, invites B from pageA1. LgCommand_MD(device): per-device leave, sets m.deviceIsMember(device) = false; when device is A1 and A2 is still a member, identity A retains one leaf (model encodes this). FdCommand_MD: check guard m.membersA1 && m.membersA2 && m.groupId !== null, A1 forgets one of A's leaves (A2's leaf by index), postcondition: leafCount(g, A) drops by 1. RdCommand_MD(device, name): renames device on its own page. Per spec, A14 wire (openNdkSubscriber) is deferred — leaf-count consequence only is asserted here.
stories.notes: ~200 LOC. LgCommand_MD's identity-A leaf semantics (AC-MD-LG-2) are the model-design subtlety: after A1.Lg while A2 is still a member, m.membersA1 = false but m.membersA2 = true, and identity A's leaf count is 1, not 0. FdCommand_MD's check guard requires BOTH A1 and A2 as members — the zero-leaf branch is unreachable under this gate (AC-MD-FD-2).

stories.name: per-device-commands
stories.title: Per-device commands: CtCommand_MD, UtCommand_MD, ScCommand_MD, AsCommand_MD, UnCommand_MD, DtCommand_MD, RlCommand_MD
stories.description: Implement the seven per-device commands adapted from the 2-party file. Each command accepts device: Device and dispatches on r.page(device). CtCommand_MD(device, title, desc): check guard m.deviceIsMember(device) && m.groupId !== null; postcondition A3. UtCommand_MD, ScCommand_MD, AsCommand_MD, UnCommand_MD, DtCommand_MD: each follows the 2-party postcondition pattern (A2/A4/A4/A4/A5 respectively). RlCommand_MD(device): reloads r.page(device), model and actual should still agree (A11). Every command's toString returns ${device}.Verb(args).
stories.notes: ~250 LOC. S3 depends on S4 because per-device commands' check guards reference m.deviceIsMember(device), which is defined in ModelStateMD and used by CgCommand_MD/InCommand_MD — having the group-lifecycle shape settled first avoids shape churn. The 2-party counterparts (Ct, Ut, Sc, As, Un, Dt) are adapted, not imported — per architecture boundary rule, the 2-party file is read-only.

stories.name: headline-assertions
stories.title: Headline assertions: assertA15_MD, assertC0_MD, assertS5_MD, assertS6_MD, assertS10_MD
stories.description: Implement the five assertion functions. assertA15_MD: guard m.groupId !== null && m.membersA1 && m.membersA2; asserts task-id sets equal (status, assignee, title per shared id), members equal, epoch equal, per-pubkey leafCount equal between A1 and A2. assertC0_MD: runs when all three devices are members; three-way comparison of tasks, members, epoch, leafCount. assertS5_MD: biconditional (p ∈ members) ⇔ (leafCount >= 1) for pubkeyA (expected 2 when both attached, 1 after Lg/Fd) and pubkeyB. assertS6_MD: each of epochSequenceA1, epochSequenceA2, epochSequenceB is non-decreasing. assertS10_MD: device-row count on pageA1 and pageA2 each equals getPubkeyLeafCountHook(page, m.groupId, m.pubkeyA). All assertions ship in both strict form (hooks present) and degraded form (AC-MD-DEG-1/2).
stories.notes: ~150 LOC. Imports getGroupEpochHook, getGroupMembersHook, getPubkeyLeafCountHook from e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts — NOT calling window hooks directly (architecture boundary rule). Degraded form code comments MUST name AC-MD-DEG-1/2 and point at epic-property-tests-l3-completion's test-hook story per AC-MD-DEG-2.
